label: ΔVH (event vs. 30-day pre-baseline)
rationale: Cross-pol depolarisation collapse — primary discriminator between saline surge (ΔVH ≈ −10.5 dB) and transplanting flood (ΔVH ≈ −6.5 dB) and freshwater rainfall (ΔVH ≈ −3.0 dB).

label: ΔCR (cross-ratio change)
rationale: Depolarisation index drops most sharply (≈ −4 dB) only under deep impulsive surge; transplanting and rainfall preserve CR structure (drops ≤ 2 dB).

label: VV minimum during event window
rationale: Specular-loss floor under smooth ponded water; separates surface-scattering regimes (deep flood) from canopy-volume regimes (shallow rainfall).

label: ERA5 3-day max wind
rationale: Cyclonic-event filter — gates mechanism (B) without which transplanting and surge events at the low-ΔVH boundary co-mingle in feature space.

label: LSWI minimum during event window
rationale: Canopy water content — separates flooded canopy (LSWI ↓ moderate) from open water (LSWI ↓ severe).

label: JRC water permanence
rationale: Excludes permanent waterbodies (rivers, ponds, aquaculture); boundary feature — small importance because most candidate pixels are pre-filtered to non-permanent rice land.

label: NDWI maximum during event window
rationale: Optical surface-water confirmation when cloud-free; small importance because cloud cover during cyclonic events makes NDWI frequently missing — radar carries the load.
